questionText:
A lexical analyzer uses the following token definitions

• $letter \rightarrow [A-Za-z]$
• $digit \rightarrow [0-9]$
• $id \rightarrow letter\,(letter \mid digit)^*$
• $number \rightarrow digit^+$
• $ws \rightarrow (blank \mid tab \mid newline)^+$

For the string given below,

$$x1 \quad 23mm \quad 78 \quad y \quad 7z \quad zz5 \quad 14A \quad 8H \quad AaYcD$$

the number of tokens (excluding $ws$) that will be produced by the lexical analyzer is __________. (answer in integer)
explanation:
Step-by-step Explanation:

1. Understand Lexical Analysis Rules:
Lexical analyzers use the Maximal Munch (longest match) principle to partition an input string into tokens:
- $id$: Begins with a letter, followed by zero or more letters or digits.
- $number$: One or more digits.
- $ws$: Whitespace characters (skipped).

2. Tokenize Each Component:
- x1: Matches $id \rightarrow$ 1 token (x1)
- 23mm: Starts with digits 23 ($number$), followed by mm ($id$) $\rightarrow$ 2 tokens (23, mm)
- 78: Matches $number \rightarrow$ 1 token (78)
- y: Matches $id \rightarrow$ 1 token (y)
- 7z: Starts with digit 7 ($number$), followed by z ($id$) $\rightarrow$ 2 tokens (7, z)
- zz5: Matches $id \rightarrow$ 1 token (zz5)
- 14A: Starts with digits 14 ($number$), followed by A ($id$) $\rightarrow$ 2 tokens (14, A)
- 8H: Starts with digit 8 ($number$), followed by H ($id$) $\rightarrow$ 2 tokens (8, H)
- AaYcD: Matches $id \rightarrow$ 1 token (AaYcD)

3. Calculate Total Token Count:
$$\text{Total Tokens} = 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 2 + 2 + 1 = 13$$

Hence, the number of tokens produced is 13.
